editorial.description_en: The first grass of the year, still short and unevenly coloured.
editorial.description_ja: 生えはじめた草のような、若い黄緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.794, C 0.066, h 116.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 雛 (hina, fledgling) + 草 (kusa, grass), rendaku to -gusa. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Fledgling Grass" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 雛草. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — haru-na at ΔE00 5.6, waka-shida at ΔE00 6.9, shin-me at ΔE00 7.1. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (296°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
